meta.name: antinet-provenance
meta.description: 软件开发工程师与信息安全分析师在构建多智能体系统时，当需全链路可观测与安全审计，请用此技能。它自动收集操作日志，生成可追溯证据链与向量索引，开箱即用实现系统审计与精准回放，让Agent运行安全透明。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 收集Agent操作日志，构建可溯源证据链，实现安全审计与精准回放。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在构建多智能体系统，需要全链路可观测与安全审计。
copy.tagline_en: Collect agent operation logs as evidence chains for audit and replay.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building multi-agent systems and need full observability and audit trails.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会记录每一次分发、扫描、解析与卡片生成事件，写入按 trace_id 串联的证据链和向量索引，并提供按 trace_id、时间窗、官署维度检索历史证据的接口。
howto.when: 在各官署的关键操作节点被调用，或由事件总线异步推送事件时接管；需要按 trace_id、时间窗做审计与回滚定位时也用它。

say.text: 把这轮军机处派发和官署执行的事件写入证据链
按 trace_id 检索这条链上的全部事件
查最近一小时扫描与解析事件的记录
say.note: 按时间窗返回查询结果

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude logs every dispatch, scan, parse and card-generation event into a trace_id-linked evidence chain plus vector index, and offers a query API by trace_id, time window and agency.
howto.when_en: It takes over when called at key operation points by each agency, or when events are pushed asynchronously via the event bus; also used for audit and rollback lookup by trace_id or time window.

say_en.text: Write this round's dispatch and agency-execution events into the evidence chain
Retrieve all events on this chain by trace_id
Show scan and parse events from the last hour
say_en.note: Returns query results by time window
